name: oxypages
description: Publish websites and built apps (React, Vue, Vite, Astro) to OxyPages from Claude Code, with no account or setup: a live link plus a claim link. Add an API key to deploy into your account through the OxyPages MCP server.

api_key.title: OxyPages API key
api_key.description: Starts with oxy_. Create one at app.oxypages.com under Profile, API Keys. Free accounts include one. Leave empty to publish 30-minute unclaimed links only.
